_help: The Green Swaps affiliate programs and our suppliers (suppliers added 2026-10-12) (owner, 2026-10-10). The dashboard's Affiliate programmes section reads this file; store.html carries the links (the Green Swaps cards, the SeedsNow shelves from tools/seedsnow-shelf.mjs, and the sidebar's partner list under Green Swaps, which shows APPROVED programmes only). When a programme approves: status to Approved, add its link here, on its card, and in the sidebar list. No passwords or payout details here: this repository is public.
check: Check earnings on the first of each month; most programmes pay only above a minimum. Every network needs the W-9 with the EIN before it pays.
